problem.title: The Problem
problem.description: Today's social platforms reward {{highlight}} . Algorithms amplify conflict because angry engagement drives clicks. The result? We've forgotten how to disagree constructively with people who think differently.
problem.engagementDesc: Rewards anger, division, and echo chambers

state.title: STATE
state.description: Share your perspective on the question. Your opinion becomes a node on the graph.

chat.title: CHAT
chat.description: Connect with people who think differently. Request conversations with other nodes.

rate.title: RATE
rate.description: Evaluate your conversation partner on empathy and disagreement to calculate bridging scores.

bridgingScore.title: The Bridging Score
bridgingScore.explanation: {{empathy}} ranges from -50 to +50. {{disagreement}} ranges from 0 to 100. Your score ranges from {{minScore}} to {{maxScore}}.
bridgingScore.disagreementRanges: ranges from 0 to 100. Your score ranges from

green.name: Green Zone
green.meaning: High empathy + High disagreement = True bridging. You understood someone you deeply disagree with.

orange.name: Orange Zone
orange.meaning: Moderate bridging potential. Good conversation, but room to grow in empathy or find deeper disagreement.

red.name: Red Zone
red.meaning: Negative empathy indicates harmful interaction. The conversation wasn't constructive.

circles.title: Concentric Circles
circles.description: The graph displays three rings representing bridging score zones. The closer to the center, the higher the bridging score.

nodes.title: Nodes & Edges
nodes.description: Each node is an opinion. Lines connecting nodes represent conversations. Thicker lines indicate deeper engagement.

top5.title: Top 5 Bridgers
top5.description: The five highest-scoring bridgers appear in the green center zone with special prominence.

position.title: Your Position
position.description: Your node is highlighted. Click other nodes to request conversations or view existing chats.

anonymous.title: Anonymous Identity
anonymous.description: Passphrase-based login with no email or phone required. Your identity stays private.

ai.title: AI Conciliation (Planned)
ai.description: AI mediator available to help de-escalate heated discussions and find common ground.

legal.title: Criminal Prosecution
legal.description: No biased community guidelines. Reported content that might break the law is hidden, and pressing charges is supported.

cta.title: Ready to bridge the divide?
cta.description: Join the conversation and discover what happens when empathy meets disagreement.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: Welcome to FreeMind! Let's walk you through the basics.

addOpinion.title: Share Your Opinion
addOpinion.text: Click the 'Add Opinion' button to share your perspective on the topic.

yourOpinion.title: Your Opinion
yourOpinion.text: This is your opinion on the map! As you chat with others, it will move to the middle.

exploreOpinions.title: Explore Others
exploreOpinions.text: Click on 2 other opinions you find interesting.

requestChat.title: Request a Chat
requestChat.text: Now click 'Request to Chat' to start a conversation.

nowWeWait.title: Now We Wait!
nowWeWait.text: Your request has been sent! Wait for someone to accept, or accept an incoming request.

chatStarted.title: Your First Chat
chatStarted.text: Use the rating scales to rate your conversation. Your ratings affect your position on the graph.

done.title: You're Ready!
done.text: Congratulations! You know everything you need. Enjoy bridging the divide!

intro.title: Your First Chat
intro.text: Great! You started a first chat.

rating.title: Rate Your Chat
rating.text: With these scales you can rate your chat.

bridging.title: Bridging Score
bridging.text: Higher scores move you closer to the center. Balanced and respectful ratings increase the score.

end.title: You Are Ready
end.text: Have fun with your first chat!

landing.trustLine: Anonymous Participation • Innovative Discourse Graph • Legally Moderated

hero.headline: Where opposites engage honestly and respectfully.
hero.subheadline: FreeMind.city is a self-regulating platform for constructive discourse. Differences of opinion become tangible – and are negotiated with respect.
hero.reassurance: No public profiles. No real names. GDPR-compliant.

polarization.title: Polarization
polarization.desc: Debates drift to extremes – productive exchange barely happens.

volume.title: Volume Over Quality
volume.desc: The most visible voices are not the most constructive.

structure.title: Missing Structure
structure.desc: There is no space where opposing views can meet in an orderly way.

discourse.title: Structured Discourse Space
discourse.desc: Every opinion gets a clear place on the public graph.

respect.title: Respect × Opposition
respect.desc: Only those who engage respectfully with real opposites move to the center.

quality.title: Visible Quality
quality.desc: Constructive exchanges become measurable – not volume.

useCases.headline: Designed for
useCases.note: FreeMind.city is not a social network. It is a structured public discourse space.

publish.title: Publish Your Opinion
publish.desc: Register anonymously with a passkey and share your position on a topic.

choose.title: Choose an Opposing Voice
choose.desc: Deliberately select a different perspective and start a 1-on-1 dialogue.

rate.title: Rate the Exchange
rate.desc: Respect and opposition become visible – the discourse reorganizes itself.

social.a: No. It is a structured discourse space with clear mechanics.

abuse.a: Through topic-specific IP logging, legally compliant reporting procedures, and transparent deletion logic under German law.

public.a: Opinions are visible, identities remain anonymous.

cta.headline: Ready for a new form of public discourse?
